sections.title: Before booking in Lexington
sections.html:
Bring photos of your natural hair, current hair and two or three looks you are considering. Ask whether the consultation covers clothing and makeup as well as hair, and whether a separate salon appointment is needed. Your stylist should assess your current color history, condition and maintenance preferences before recommending a process. Avoid booking a complicated change solely from a palette name.

  • Is hair coloring booked and charged separately from analysis?
  • Can the consultation help me compare specific hair references?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: Stylist AI can help you compare a hair-color preview with your usual clothing colors before the appointment. Save the looks you enjoy and explain what appeals to you: depth, softness or contrast. Keep one familiar makeup look while comparing, so you are not changing every feature at once. A useful outcome is a short list to discuss with the salon, not an instruction to bleach or dye at home.
